title: console sidebar: the ⋯ menu's Design entry opens the metadata-admin page, which calls a packaged object locked, while the app bar's Edit app opens Studio's Data surface for the same object — one designer, one destination
body:
Filing gate ① (a product defect, measured on `main`), filed on the maintainer's word (chat, 2026-10-15, session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, seat account os-bill): the seat ran a functional audit of the HotCRM console on objectui `main` `720f6d4` (report, private to the maintainer: https://claude.ai/artifact/XPrn5eZMsQaKUgasMJEMmR, finding F2, figures 11 and 12), and the maintainer answered 「同意开卡，使用 pm-dispatch 创建卡片」. Quota note: the audit's cards exceed the filing gate's three-per-fire quota on that word, which approved the report's card list as a set.

Parent: #12444; a follow-up of #12427's merged half (PR #12443, `a8e5b73`, which added the Design entry). Blocks nothing; nothing blocks it.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` lane's next dispatch (seat post #9800), one dev round in `@object-ui/app-shell` (`SidebarItemMenu.tsx` and its tests), size S.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, read 2026-10-15T14:14Z): "sidebar item menu Design entry opens metadata admin route instead of Studio locked metadata read-only packaged app designer" → 15, top 8 read: #12496 (open, a `?tab=` deep link on the metadata item page), #12306, #12303, #12169 (Studio offered Edit on a packaged item the server refuses, ADR-0131 D6), #11781, #11591, #11167, #11153 (closed, Studio pillars). None is this card; #12169 is the ruling this card follows (a managed item is never edited outside what the hatch allows).

## What happens

Two controls say "design this object" and land on different pages. The app bar's Edit app button (pencil) opens Studio's Data surface for the current object: `/studio/app.objectstack.hotcrm/data?surface=object:crm_lead`, with the object's fields, forms, validations, hooks, actions, API and settings tabs. The sidebar entry's ⋯ menu's Design entry (and the Design entry of an `object:` / `dashboard:` / `page:` favorite) opens the metadata-admin page `/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/metadata/object/crm_lead`, which for the packaged HotCRM object shows a create-only badge and the notice that the metadata is locked and cannot be edited or deleted (`app.objectstack.hotcrm@4.0.1`), then a read-only field list. A maintainer who clicks Design from the sidebar is told the object cannot be designed; the same maintainer who clicks the pencil designs it.

## Readings (objectui `origin/main` `720f6d4`, read 2026-10-15T14:15Z)

1. `packages/app-shell/src/layout/SidebarItemMenu.tsx` lines 61–72 (`sidebarItemDesignPath`) and 81–86 (`favoriteDesignPath`): both build `${basePath}/metadata/${type}/${name}`, the metadata-admin router (`metadata/:type/:name`, declared by `DefaultAppContent`), chosen on #12427 because `PageView`'s Edit-in-studio button sends a page there.
2. `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx` lines 371 and 720–728: the Edit app button opens `studioDesignPath`, the Studio surface for the route's item (`/studio/:packageId/data?surface=object:NAME` for an object; the comment at line 715 names `interfaces?surface=dashboard:NAME` for a dashboard).
3. Browser reading (1440, HotCRM, admin): Edit app → the Studio Data surface, 线索 · `crm_lead` · 45 fields, seven tabs. Sidebar ⋯ → Design → the metadata page with the locked notice, 9.1 s after the click in dev mode (the chunk), 0.3 s of its own loading.

## What to build

1. The sidebar ⋯ menu's Design entry and the favorites' Design entry open the same destination the app bar's Edit app opens for that item type: the Studio surface (`studioDesignPath`'s derivation, shared, not a second table). An `object` entry opens the Data surface with `surface=object:NAME`; a `dashboard` entry the Interfaces surface with `surface=dashboard:NAME`; a `page` entry whatever the app bar opens for a page today. One derivation for both controls; `sidebarItemDesignPath` / `favoriteDesignPath` become callers of it or go.
2. The entry's gate stays what #12427 set (admin and `canAuthorMetadata`); a packaged item still opens, read-only, where Studio already shows packaged items read-only (#12169's ruling), with no "locked" dead end.
3. The metadata-admin route itself is untouched: it keeps its own entry points.

## Acceptance

- `SidebarItemMenu` tests: the Design entry of an `object`, `dashboard` and `page` navigation entry, and of the matching favorites, resolves to the same path the app bar's Edit app resolves for that item; the existing gate tests (admin, authoring, no entry for `url` / `component` / records / apps) unchanged.
- Browser reading by the landing seat at 1440 on HotCRM: sidebar Leads ⋯ → Design and the app bar's pencil on the Leads list land on the same Studio Data surface for `crm_lead`.
- `pnpm test` from the repo root green on the affected files; a changeset (patch) for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Out of scope

- Studio's read-only presentation of packaged items; the metadata-admin page's own content; adding Design for entry types #12427 left undecided.

Attribution: written by the domain:ui seat in session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP` (account os-bill) on the maintainer's words quoted above.
